tex_content.html:
If two Ricci flows agree at $t_0$ and their associated Ricci--DeTurck flows agree on $[t_0,T]$, then the Ricci flows agree on $[t_0,T]$.
Proof

\sketch Equality of pullback metrics identifies the two harmonic-map-flow diffeomorphisms by uniqueness, and hence the original metrics.

□
